en.name: Nicholas III
en.summary: A pope of the powerful Orsini family who reorganized the Papal States' administration and rebuilt the Vatican as a papal residence.
en.body: Nicholas III, a member of the prominent Roman Orsini family, worked to strengthen direct papal governance over the Papal States and negotiated with the emperor Rudolf I to secure recognition of papal territorial claims in central Italy. He undertook substantial building and fortification of the Vatican palace, shifting papal residence away from the aging Lateran complex and toward the area that would become the modern Vatican.
